prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A whimsical, close-up photograph of a unicorn-themed cupcake placed on a white plate, set against a rich, deep purple background. The cupcake features a golden, spiraled unicorn horn and two white ears with pink centers made from fondant, emerging from a swirl of vibrant, multicolored frosting in shades of blue, yellow, and pink, atop a base of creamy white icing. Rainbow sprinkles are scattered generously over the frosting and plate, adding playful texture and color. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy sheen of the horn and the soft, inviting texture of the cupcake. The composition is centered, with a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the background and plate edges, drawing full attention to the cupcake’s intricate details. The overall mood is cheerful and magical, evoking a sense of celebration and fantasy, with a polished, high-contrast photographic style reminiscent of professional food photography.
